ideas.pitch: A lightweight sensor dashboard mounted on the RC chassis that streams motor temperature, battery voltage, and RPM over ESP32 Wi-Fi to a web frontend, minimizing mechanical failures during heat races.
ideas.title: PitStop Telemetry: Real-Time RC Car Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Winners are judged on combined assembly and racing time; catching a failing motor or overheating battery before the final heat prevents catastrophic DNFs.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-responsive web tool where builders input their assembled gear ratios and chassis weight to instantly calculate optimal cornering speeds and gear configurations for the track layout.
ideas.title: AeroTune: CFD & Gear Ratio Calculator for RC Chassis
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gives an engineering-focused edge to the assembly phase by translating mechanical changes into predicted track performance.

ideas.pitch: A standalone webcam-based lap counter that uses color-tracking and OpenCV to automatically log car lap times and speeds as vehicles pass the finish line.
ideas.title: LapTimer Pro: Computer Vision Race Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an automated, demo-ready live timing board that solves the event's need for precise multi-round heat tracking.

ideas.pitch: An Arduino-based strain gauge and accelerometer module clipped onto the RC suspension during test runs to detect chassis flex and impact forces.
ideas.title: TorqueGuard: Mechanical Stress Analysis Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases hard engineering and physical hardware prototyping that stands out in a racing competition focused on build quality.

ideas.pitch: A step-by-step augmented reality web app that uses voice commands and computer vision to verify correct screw sizes and part placements during the high-speed assembly phase.
ideas.title: QuickBuild Checklist: AR-Guided RC Assembly Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the assembly time component of the final score by reducing human error and assembly mistakes under time pressure.
